data.title: Create a reversible section cut
data.summary: One building mesh and a horizontal cut height of 1.2 m. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Three.js materials expose clipping-plane controls for compatible rendering paths.

prerequisites: An authorized Three.js / WebXR environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: One building mesh and a horizontal cut height of 1.2 m.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent section view workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: One building mesh and a horizontal cut height of 1.2 m. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Use the existing material pipeline and configure a supported clipping plane
Make cut height adjustable and keep clipping state out of the source mesh
Provide a reset and explain whether open cut faces are capped or simply clipped

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned create a reversible section cut candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Reset restores the complete model without permanent geometry edits
All participating materials obey the same cut plane
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: A clipped view may expose hollow geometry and does not create a fabrication-ready section.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Cap rendering is a separate feature; do not imply it exists from clipping alone.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me create a reversible section cut in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: One building mesh and a horizontal cut height of 1.2 m. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Reset restores the complete model without permanent geometry edits; All participating materials obey the same cut plane. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
